Jade Belwyn belongs to the Belgian Belwyn family of Bruges, and she grew up believing a plate could be as serious as a portrait. 🏰💖 Canal light over linen, gold rims, and the idea that a family meal is a ceremony were the early lessons. She likes the name best on the rim of a cup, small enough to notice only when the cup is lifted. The studio is where that ceremony begins, before anyone has sat down. Flowers and monograms wait their turn like guests. 🌸

She is a porcelain painter, decorating family china in a bright studio, usually in jade-green silk and a linen apron. 🍵✨ Fine brushes, gold paint, and stacked plates surround a border that does not hurry. She lays a leaf, a scroll, a hair of gold, and she will not fire a piece while a line still sulks. Cousins ask for a service for a wedding breakfast or a single cup for a portrait sitting, something that can survive a century of careful washing. Mineral

title: Katherine Roccabruna [LORA/ZImageTurbo]
description:
This LoRA does not depict a real person; it is a fictional creation.

Katherine Roccabruna grew up in the RoccaBruna family of Florence, surrounded by palazzos that were already lessons in furniture. 🌟 Stone, proportion, and the way a chair changes a conversation were household knowledge. She sketches because the hand still knows things a screen rushes past. The city remains both client and teacher.

As a furniture designer she builds pieces that have to hold a body and a story at the same time. 🎨 A table begins as a drawing, then as wood chosen at a market, then as a stubborn round of joinery. Florentine elegance and a modern line argue until they agree. She cares whether a drawer will still run smoothly in ten years. 🪑 The workshop smells of timber and varnish, and the afternoon disappears into that smell on purpose.

Evening might be a cafe sketch or a walk with no pencil at all. ☕🇮🇹 She likes seeing other people's rooms lit up, each one a small museum of choices.

title: RetroMix XL - 80s Retro Anime Cel Merge (Illustrious) [Checkpoint/Illustrious]
description:
RetroMix XL is a three-way checkpoint merge that reconstructs the 1980s TV anime look: warm faded palettes, hand-painted cel shading, visible film grain, dramatic sunset skies and that unmistakable retro city-pop mood, while keeping the stable anatomy of the Illustrious ecosystem.

Recipe: 0.45 x NEW ERA (New Esthetic Retro Anime) + 0.30 x WAI-illustrious-SDXL v17 + 0.25 x Illustrious-XL-v1.0, applied to the UNet only (VAE and text encoder inherited from the first model).

What you get:

  • 80s palette: warm creams, dusty oranges, teal shadows instead of modern saturated neon

  • - Grainy film texture and slightly soft optical edges, like a scanned cel

  • - Retro city-pop framing: rooftops, seaside towns, telephone poles at dusk

Great for retro posters, cassette / album cover art, nostalgic illustration, vaporwave-adjacent scenes and period-correct anime throwbacks. Add '1980s retro anime, vintage cel animation

title: MOSS-Image SFT DeBand | Banding Fix LoRAs [LORA/MOSS Image]
description:
MOSS-Image SFT can produce noticeable vertical color banding, particularly in skies, gradients, fog, and large areas of uniform color.

These two weight-difference adapters reduce the artifact by restoring selected transformer layers to their MOSS-Image Base weights, without requiring a full replacement checkpoint.

Main (L37–41) provides the standard correction and can be used on its own at strength 1.0.

Extra (L32–36) extends the correction when stacked with Main, also at strength 1.0. Using both produces the stronger DeBand+ configuration.

The included ComfyUI workflow provides presets for different quality and speed configurations.

These files use ComfyUI's full-rank .diff format rather than conventional low-rank LoRA matrices. Use a compatible ComfyUI loader.
